<!-- A heading over one centered row of logo slots (LogoSlot); the row and slot sizes come from the default preset. -->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";

  export type LogoRibbonProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    logos: Logo[];
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import LogoSlot from "../components/logo-slot.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { id, title, logos, tone = "default", density = "default", landmarkLabel }: LogoRibbonProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  measure="fill"
  align="center"
  class="py-0"
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Stack gap="6" align="center" data-testid="logos-block">
    <Title as={2} size="xl" weight="semibold" class="leading-7" id={(id + "-title")}>
      {title}
    </Title>
    <Group
      gap="0"
      justify="center"
      align="start"
      class={cn("flex w-full flex-wrap", defaults.logos.row)}
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each logos as logo (logo.id)}
        <LogoSlot name={logo.name} icon={logo.icon} />
      {/each}
    </Group>
  </Stack>
</SectionFrame>
